subject: QBR packet curation & rollup — assemble manager inputs by Fri
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: QBR packet curation & rollup — assemble manager inputs by Fri

Hi all,

We're starting the QBR packet assembly for the Nov leadership review. Goal: produce a clean, 1-page per-commit lead packet plus a 2-page stage rollup for execs. I attached the packet template and the latest stage snapshot to make this quick.

What I need from each manager by end-of-day Friday (11/06):
- Updated rows in qbr_packet_template_v2.xlsx for each commit you think is in-scope. Use the "Commit? (Y/N)" column — be conservative on commits.
- For every commit flagged Y: add a 2-3 sentence rationale, top-3 risks, and any blocker owners.
- Mark deals > $100k with bold and populate the HubSpot ID field.
- If a commit is conditional (needs procurement/legal), set Status = "Pending Legal" and add expected clearance date.

Operational notes:
- Monica: can you coordinate pack assembly? We need a single compiled deck by next Tuesday morning so leadership can review before the Friday QBR.
- Laura & Grace: please prioritize stage-level deltas and provide a rollup paragraph (3 bullets) of any net changes to expected revenue.
- Karthik: please include any pipeline hygiene flags (stale contacts, dupes, missing ARR confirmations) in the snapshot.

I'll compile once you drop in updated templates; we will use the Drive folder (link below) and I will circulate a draft for review on Monday evening. If you anticipate not meeting the Friday deadline, highlight which commits will be late so we can triage.

Attachments: qbr_packet_template_v2.xlsx, stage_snapshot_20261101.csv
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QBRpacket_Redwood_2026
HubSpot batch id: HS-93472

Thanks — short and actionable please.

Jonas
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QBR packet curation & rollup — assemble manager inputs by Fri

Thanks Jonas — will do. Quick clarifying questions:
1) For the "commit rationale" field, do you want a customer-value focused summary or an internal technical justification? I can do both but want a single canonical paragraph.
2) On forecast adjustments: should managers propose an updated commit ARR (best case) or leave the current forecast and note changes in the rollup paragraph?

I'm attaching my draft commit list (LA_commit_list_draft.csv) — I flagged three deals that need procurement alignment and one that we should move to "watch".

I can have a clean template back to you by Thurs midday. If we want to reduce back-and-forth, recommend a 30-minute sync Wed 10–10:30 to align on formatting.

Laura Bennett
Manager, West Region Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachment: LA_commit_list_draft.csv (csv)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QBR packet curation & rollup — assemble manager inputs by Fri

Got it — I'll take lead on pack assembly. Actioning:
- I'll consolidate all manager templates into the master deck on Monday night (11/08) and post a compiled PDF to the Drive.
- I've assigned Priya (cc'd internally on my side) to help with formatting and HubSpot cross-checks; she'll surface any HS ID mismatches.
- I'll schedule a 2-hr assembly window Wed 11/10 1–3pm PT to finalize visuals and run spell-checks. Please hold that time.

Note: Procurement is reviewing a redline for the large EDU deal Laura flagged — that could change commit status to "conditional". Laura, please mark expected resolution date in the template.

Also tagging Grace: Grace, can you take stage-level delta bullets for PM review? Two short bullets per stage (+/- expected ARR).

Thanks — I'll update the Drive link once the master is started.

Monica Patel
Director, Go-to-Market Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QBR packet curation & rollup — assemble manager inputs by Fri

Thanks team — appreciate the quick turns. Summary / next steps: 

- Laura: finalize your sheet Thu EOD with the procurement dates inline.
- Monica: proceed with assembly; deliver compiled PDF to Drive by Mon 11/08 20:00 PT. Include a one-page "ask" for any leadership decisions (discount approvals, SLA exceptions).
- Grace: deliver stage delta bullets by Fri 11/06 EOD; keep to 3 bullets per stage.
- Karthik: run the hygiene script against the snapshot and add a short list of 5 high-risk records.

I've pasted the Drive folder here (final compile will live in /Final/ExecDeck.pdf): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QBRpacket_Redwood_2026
HubSpot batch for cross-check: HS-93472
Doc for assembly rules: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/pack-assembly-instructions

I'll pull numbers with finance on Monday AM to validate roll totals before the packet goes to leadership. If anything changes after you upload, mark the template with a color-coded change note and add a short reason.

Onward — clean inputs make a short review.

Jonas
